correctness.rationale: The exact AM/GM range-minimization formula is proved via derivatives with endpoints fixed, and the normalized range-to-total-variation inequality follows from the convex chord with p-weighted mean 1. Zero-sum positive/negative increments imply Euclidean square ≤2 TV². The hyperbolic identity yields global 2/n; the strictly positive two-active-coordinate family proves sharpness. The pathwise rate corollary telescopes exact relative wealth and uses compactness and the all-window squared-displacement assumption. Standalone script checked 68982 grid pairs, 39000 range cases, 19800 random pairs, 81 boundary cases, 24 two-cycle cases; none is used as universal proof.

value.rationale: A natural unresolved quantitative gap in recent research is a volatility-growth coefficient robust to state spaces approaching the simplex boundary. The exact 2/n constant works globally for arbitrary jumps in every dimension, strengthens the source compact-coercivity and worst-case rate lower bound, and has a matching two-coordinate extremizing construction. These are structural inequalities and sharp dynamical consequences for the motivating framework; no universal equality of growth rates is claimed.
